findings.issue: A valid digit-only positive done ID longer than Python's 4,300-digit conversion limit raises an uncaught ValueError and prints a traceback. The specification places no length limit on positive base-10 IDs and requires exact diagnostics with no tracebacks; on missing data this valid ID should instead reach the not-found check.
findings.fix: Support arbitrary-length numeric IDs consistently (including JSON decoding), e.g. disable or safely accommodate Python's integer-string digit limit before parsing IDs and todo JSON.
findings.evidence: 42 tests passed; manual 4,301-digit ID reproduced traceback.
